$$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}\frac{\partial t}{\partial x}=f'(t)e^x,\quad\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}\frac{\partial t}{\partial y}=-f'(t)e^{-y}$$

$$\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\right)=f''(t)e^{2x}+f'(t)e^x$$

$$\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y^2}=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\right)=-f''(t)(-e^{-y})e^{-y}+f'(t)e^{-y}=f''(t)e^{-2y}+f'(t)e^{-y}$$

$$\text{则：}\quad\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y^2}=(e^{2x}+e^{-2y})f''(t)+(e^x+e^{-y})f'(t)$$
